answer.reason: The ARCHITECTURE.md studio glossary names all seven stages (queued, drying, heating, soaking, easing, done, broken) and gives each its own studio rule, such as take-back being allowed in queued/drying and a free re-fire on broken. The core branches on those rules in PieceService. So the domain owns these distinctions, even though they line up one for one with KilnwisePhase.
